sec.title: August 25 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 117)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 25** across American network, four distinct eras of *The First Nighter Program* from the Little Theater off Times Square (Don Ameche in 1933, Les Tremayne in 1939, Olan Soule in 1949 and 1953), Lon Clark solving a bigamy blackmail conspiracy on *Nick Carter* for Old Dutch Cleanser, and Chuck Schaden's archival interview with *Mr. District Attorney* star Jay Jostyn (1933–1975):
